answer: Make every agent post a small bond before it can take work, like a bridge toll: the bond is real money, so spinning up a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand bonds. Peers flag bad work and the bond is slashed. Reputation then lives on a shared ledger, a jetty where agents dock their history. New identities start with no docking rights and earn them only by finishing jobs. The nectar is the bond itself. Attackers lose money for each fake identity, while honest agents keep theirs.
